intent.expectation: feasible for some seeds only; infeasibility is provable rather than merely unproven
intent.exercises: the boundary of what fits the 255 m gateway, so that the seed decides the outcome
notes: The material is restricted to one super type with two sub types of very different length: VIRM-4 at 108.56 m and VIRM-6 at 162.06 m. With units_per_composition [1,2] a train is one unit (always fits) or two, and a pair fits only if both draws are VIRM-4: 4+4 = 217.1 m fits, 4+6 = 270.6 m and 6+6 = 324.1 m do not. So each train fits with probability about 0.625 and the scenario is feasible only when every train does.

Everything else is deliberately copied from feasible_small — same gateway spacing, same horizon, no servicing — so that the seed varies exactly one thing: whether the drawn compositions fit. Do not tighten min_gap_on_gateway here; that would confound length with congestion, which is what marginal_congestion is for.

An infeasible outcome here is a proof, not an opinion: the evaluator rejects the scenario before considering any plan, because a train cannot fit on the track it is scheduled to arrive at or depart from.
